item.title: [+1] India-US trade deal: CEA Nageswaran says bilateral friction easing ahead of potential December pact
item.description:
Signal: trade deal or tariff relief for India (India). 31 reports from Scroll.in, Apparel Resources, Reuters and 26 more. Related: “Big hiccup! Scotch whisky faces 162.5% duty despite India-UK trade deal: Why shipments are stuck and what went wrong”. Ongoing: also reported on 6 of the previous 7 days (first 12 Nov).

Capital goods & infra: mild tailwind (+1) — Engineering exports gain access

Why it matters: Lower tariffs or a trade deal open markets for Indian exporters and attract investment into export manufacturing.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Rupee +1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: high · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] AC makers shine as copper extends fall; Voltas, Blue Star rally up to 8%
item.description:
Signal: lower metal prices. 3 reports from BigMint, Business Standard, cwibc.co.id. Related: “India: Copper cathode prices slide as LME correction pressures domestic market”. Turn: earlier readings (12 Nov) pointed the other way.

Capital goods & infra: mild tailwind (+1) — Input costs ease

Why it matters: Falling metal prices cut Indian producers' realisations, often on weak Chinese demand, while easing input costs for manufacturers.

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks
